Kiplinger's October 28, 2026 analysis describes a late-cycle market rather than a confirmed peak [e1]. limitations: The market commentary does not establish whether the undefined collapse condition has occurred.

No collapse threshold or post-collapse survival interval is specified; continued operation cannot conclusively support this deadline-free forecast.

our_interpretation: Die means fail as an operating business, rather than suffer a share-price decline, layoffs or lower profits.
Google refers to the Google/Alphabet business, not the survival of a particular legal subsidiary name.
The antecedent requires an identifiable collapse of the AI investment boom. The speaker supplies no market threshold or duration.
A failure must be caused materially by that collapse; chronological sequence alone is insufficient.
criteria.support_condition: Following an identifiable AI bubble collapse and its material business consequences, all four named businesses survive as operating enterprises.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one named business fails or permanently ceases operating as a material consequence of that collapse.
